messages:
Maya Torres: Heads-up — StellarHealth sent a post-migration feature wishlist. They bundled a few asks that could impact renewal. Pasting their note below and would like to triage.

Ben Liu: can you paste the email here so product can see the exact wording?

Maya Torres: ```From: sara@stellarhealth.com
Hi team, thanks for the smooth migration. A few things we'd love to see soon: 1) Prompt-level cost attribution per team (we need CSV exports) 2) Ability to pin custom quantized model snapshots for consistent perf during audits 3) Role-based prompt templates + approval workflow for clinical users 4) Offline export of conversation transcripts with redaction hooks
These are blocking our finance and compliance teams. Interested in timeline and interim workarounds. — Sara (Head of Integrations)```

Raj Patel: who on product should we loop in? This feels like a mix of billing, model management, and governance.

Alice Kim: agree. My quick read: 1 & 4 are blockers for finance/compliance (affect renewal). 2 is a model infra ask (Dedicated/Private). 3 is more of a UX/enablement effort.

Maya Torres: suggested triage (my ranking): 1) Prompt-level cost exports — P1 (affects invoicing) 2) RBAC + approval templates — P1 (compliance risk) 3) Offline transcript export w/ redaction hooks — P2 (workaround possible: manual export + script) 4) Pin custom quantized snapshots — P3 (longer infra effort)

SupportBot: Created CS ticket CS-2026-1127 for StellarHealth and attached the inbound email.

Ben Liu: +1 on priorities. Proposed next steps: a) Quick discovery call with Sara to confirm scope & adoption numbers (15–30m) b) Capture minimal acceptance criteria for each ask (csv fields, RBAC roles, redaction rules) c) Create GH issues and tag product-area owners

Maya Torres: I can set the call for tomorrow 10am PT. Sara said Finance + Comms will attend.

Alice Kim: I can run the discovery and draft acceptance criteria. Will capture initial mocks for RBAC templates and a sample CSV schema.

Raj Patel: I will create high-level GH epics: eng-billing, eng-governance, eng-models and link to CS-2026-1127. Assign eng-billing as owner for prompt-cost exports during discovery.

Maya Torres: cool. Action items: Alice -> discovery + ACs; Raj -> GH epics & owners; Ben -> follow up on interim export script; Maya -> schedule call + update ticket.

Ben Liu: small note: interim workaround idea for prompt-level costs — log token attribution per request with route tag, push daily CSV to S3. Low-effort PoC before product work.

Alice Kim: sounds good. I'll include that as a recommended interim in the discovery doc.

Maya Torres: thanks all. Marking this thread for follow-up after the call. :calendar:
